spec.assertion: No StatKey expresses healing magnitude and the `heal` effect carries no HP amount in v1, so the line is unmodellable (it.skip). The live assertion is inertness: no skill1 buff effect carries value 35.2, and sora emits zero damage-relevant buffApply events in the control fight. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'park 35.2 on atkPct/attackDamagePct because healing has no home', which would give her a permanent self damage buff.

spec.kitLine: Activates at start of battle, self
spec.assertion: Trigger identity is `passive` (start-of-battle, continuous, self) - but with a GAP payload it is behaviourally unobservable; covered only by the zero-buff inertness assertion.

No part-destroy trigger kind exists AND the scope-lock boss is partless, so the whole block must be behaviourally inert: emptying skill2 leaves totals() byte-identical to the control. RED under every nearest-wrong re-key (passive / fullBurstEnter / burstCast / hitCount), each of which lands a team-wide casterAtkPct. Non-vacuity is proved by a synthetic passive-keyed clone of the same grant, which raises both the board sum and crown's total.

Structural: if a casterAtkPct buff is authored it must be value 23.74 with durationSec 15 and no durationShots; and no atkPct buff of 23.74 may exist. Fails under the nearest-wrong target-scaled reading (atkPct scales each ally's OWN ATK, giving a different magnitude per teammate, instead of a flat add of 23.74% of sora's ATK). Runtime magnitude is untestable because the trigger cannot fire at scope.

A heal-overflow reservoir; v1 models no HP pool and no heal magnitude, so it has no payload. Assertion: no buff effect in any slot carries value 5.36. Fails under the nearest-wrong casterMaxHpPct/targetMaxHpPct 5.36 encoding, which would be a real permanent stat grant capable of feeding an atkOfMaxHpPct consumer.

Duration semantics are wall-clock seconds (not rounds) and the 5-stack cap belongs to the Storage, not to the ATK line - so no maxStacks:5 should ride the ATK buff. Covered structurally by the casterAtkPct shape check (durationSec 15, no durationShots).

Must be a `heal` effect on a burstCast trigger targeting allies (no excludeSelf), and must NOT be a casterMaxHpPct/targetMaxHpPct/maxHpPct buff of 52.27. Behaviourally: with a recovery SENSOR injected onto crown (atkPct buff on a {kind:'recovery'} trigger) in the helm-free comp, crown's total is strictly higher with the heal live than with heal effects stripped. Fails under (a) heal missing, (b) heal scoped self-only, (c) heal encoded as a Max HP stat grant - which fires no recovery trigger - and (d) trigger keyed to fullBurstEnter rather than her own cast.
The burst text carries no damage clause: no flatDamage/dot/hitRepeat/storedHit/weaponSwap effect may appear in the burst slot. Fails under an invented burst nuke.
The sim models no ally debuffs, so the cleanse has no observable payload (it.skip). Recorded so the line is not silently dropped.

fixtures: controlComp('sora', true) (liter B1 / crown B2 / sora / helm B3) for the skill1 + skill2 work - full rotation, fixed B3 present, deterministic, no seed. controlComp('sora', false) for every burst assertion: helm is the fixture's other healer, and her heals would keep the injected recovery sensor on crown permanently satisfied, hiding whether sora's own burst heal ever lands. Seven hoisted runs total: control(+events), skill2-emptied, skill2-re-keyed-passive(+events, carries a uniquely-valued critDamagePct 7.77 sentinel whose casterIdx identifies sora's slot), helm-free plain, helm-free burst-tracer, sensor+heal-on, sensor+heal-off. Two structural risks are handled defensively: the override slot arrays are read through a helper that tolerates both `ov[slot]: Block[]` and `ov[slot].blocks`, and sora being a Burst I in the carry slot alongside liter means her casting at all is a fixture fact - a 1000% tracer hit on her burstCast measures it, and the tandem assertion is gated (it.runIf) on that measurement so a fixture limitation cannot masquerade as a kit divergence.
gaps: it.skip skill1 'scales healing output by 35.2%' - no outgoing-healing StatKey; the `heal` effect models no HP amount, so the magnitude is unobservable in v1.
it.skip burst 'removes 1 debuff' - no ally-debuff system in the sim; no observable payload.

skill2 as a whole is dispositioned GAP rather than FAITHFUL: the activation clause is part destruction, there is no part-destroy trigger kind in the schema, and the scope-lock boss is partless. Both the ATK grant and the Storage are therefore magnitude-untestable at runtime and are asserted structurally plus by whole-block inertness.

The burst-heal tandem assertion is gated on the tracer test ('sora actually casts her Burst I'). If the tracer goes RED, the burst heal is untested at this fixture and needs a comp without a competing Burst I - a fixture finding, not a driver divergence.

The recovery-sensor probe proves the heal reaches teammates but cannot verify the 52.27% MAGNITUDE - the engine's heal effect carries no HP amount. Magnitude is unobservable by construction, not merely untested.
